info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create E Branch Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The E-Branch Operational Actions API enables the seamless creation and management of electronic branch operational activities. Designed for banking institutions, this API facilitates the initiation of specific operational actions to enhance customer services and streamline branch operations. Typical consumers include financial service providers and developers working on digital banking solutions. Use this API to efficiently manage your e-branch functionalities and respond proactively to operational needs.

post.summary: Create an operational action for e-branch.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an operational action specific to the e-branch channel. It is designed to enable various operational tasks that improve the functionality and service delivery of the e-branch.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to perform operational actions specific to the e-branch. It should contain the necessary parameters required for the operation, formatted as JSON.
